The '''fin-headed species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Biology and appearance==
This species was bipedal in form, with [[Color/Legends|green]] skin. Its most notable feature was a narrow fin-like protrusion extending from the top of its head and extending backwards. It had yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].

==History==
[[Unidentified alien Junkfort Station cantina patron|One member]] of this species lived on [[Junkfort Station/Legends|Junkfort Station]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. This station banned [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], but when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] visited the station while searching for a [[power gem]], this individual and his [[Human/Legends|Human]] companion decided to try and capture Solo and claim his [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Solo, however, realized their plan and avoided their initial [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shot. Engaging in a brawl with the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], the fin-headed individual was about to overpower him when Solo's [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] companion [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] joined the fight and overpowered Solo's assailants.

Another fin-headed individual lived on [[Antipose]] where [[Raskar]], a former member of the [[Iridium Pirates/Legends|Pirates of Iridium]], was hosting a gladiatorial contest for a power gem. When Solo and Chewbacca arrived on the planet, this individual watched as Chewbacca fought the leading contender in a courtyard outside of the official tournament [[Antipose Arena|arena]].
